title: Count Substrings That Differ By One Character
description: Given two strings s and t, find the number of pairs of substrings (one from s, one from t) that differ by exactly one character.
pseudocode:
1. count = 0
2. for i from 0 to s.length-1:
3.   for j from 0 to t.length-1:
4.     m = 0, diff = 0
5.     while i+m < s.length and j+m < t.length:
6.       if s[i+m] != t[j+m]: diff++
7.       if diff == 1: count++
8.       if diff > 1: break
9.       m++
10. return count
